opinions.text: Richard Gordon Burns, of Corte Madera, Cal., having requested to resign as a member of the Bar of this Court, it is ordered that his name be stricken from the roll of attorneys admitted to practice before the Bar of this Court. The rule to show cause, heretofore issued on December 8, 1986 [ante, p. 1003], is hereby discharged. The Chief Justice and Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this order.
